description: Single and two storey side to rear extension; conversion of garage to habitable room; single storey rear extension; roof lights in side and rear roof slopes; external alterations
decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The roof area of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

The window(s) and rooflights in the side elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: Form 4 – Reasonable Exception Statement, P-01B, P-02A, P-03B, P-04B, P-06A, R0977 FRA-v1, R0977 -Rev - V1.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

<p>Notwithstanding the approved details and prior to the commencement of development, full details of the permeable paving construction and details relating to the long term maintenance and management of the on-site drainage shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Details thereby approved shall be retained thereafter.</p>

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
